name: Sentinel.ai
tagline: Watches live camera streams, flags notable events in one-line alerts and logs a verifiable record.
problem: Security cameras record around the clock but people review only a small fraction.
solution: Detection, a notability gate with a custom classifier, face recognition and an LLM summary turn frames into events with timestamps, media links and on-chain references, deployed on a cloud server.
demo_moment: Team-described: a deployed run watching two streams that caught a snack thief.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Solana” among 307 submissions.
Reports its own classifier accuracy (83% on notable events).

lessons: Report your model's real accuracy; it builds more trust than a perfect demo.
